answer: A hosted agent economy can starve Sybils by making each profitable action carry a locked deposit that scales with how many identities an operator controls. Deposits settle only after a slow cooling window, so standing up five thousand puppets means posting five thousand stakes that sit frozen and can be slashed on collusion. Agents prove honest work through sealed puzzles, a fresh cipher per epoch, so one wallet cannot sign a long sonnet of tasks at once. Cluster scoring plus deposit cost makes each sock puppet cost real capital, like breaking quartz bare-handed.
